title: Alsomebob's Missing Blocks
description: This mod Adds more varients of materials while keeping the vanilla art style and crafting progression intact.
body:
🧱 Alsomebob's Missing Blocks 🧱

❓ Ever started building only to realize a block you're using doesn't have stairs, slabs, or walls?

✨ Alsomebob's Missing Blocks completes Minecraft's unfinished block families by adding the building blocks that feel like they should have been in vanilla from the beginning.

🎨 This mod expands existing materials with new variants while keeping the vanilla art style and crafting progression intact.

    📦 Includes new blocks for:
-🪨 Basalt
-🪨 Smooth Basalt
-🪨 Polished Basalt
-🌊 Prismarine
-🌊 Dark Prismarine
-🌊 Prismarine Bricks
-⚫ Obsidian
-😢 Crying Obsidian
-🎍 Bamboo Mosaic
-🪨 Dripstone
-🟤 Mud
-🧱 Packed Mud
-🟪 Purpur
-🌌 End Stone
-🤍 Calcite
      🏗️ Also adds Slabs, Stairs & Walls for:
-⬛ Coal Block
-⚪ Iron Block
-🟨 Gold Block
-💎 Diamond Block
-💚 Emerald Block
-💙 Lapis Block
-❤️ Redstone Block
-💜 Amethyst Block
-🛡️ Netherite Block
    🔨 New block types include:
-🪜 Stairs
-🧱 Slabs
-🧱 Walls
-🚧 Fences
-🚪 Fence Gates
-🚪 Doors
-🔲 Trapdoors
-⬜ Pressure Plates
-🔘 Buttons

🌿 Every block is designed to blend seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft, making this the perfect mod for builders who want more options without changing the game's overall feel.
